mapper.select: SELECT s.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.unit AS unit, SUM(s.stock_qty) AS totalQty, COUNT(*) AS storeCount FROM inv_store_material_stock s JOIN bom_material m ON m.id = s.material_id GROUP BY s.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit ORDER BY totalQty DESC
